mainEntity.name: What kind of compensation can I receive in a wrongful death case?

acceptedAnswer.text: Compensation in a wrongful death case aims to cover various losses suffered by the surviving family. This can include economic damages such as the financial support the deceased would have provided, funeral and burial expenses, and the value of household services. Non-economic damages may also be awarded for the loss of companionship, comfort, affection, solace, moral support, and sexual relations. The specific damages awarded depend on the unique circumstances of each case and the evidence presented.
acceptedAnswer.description: Compensation in a wrongful death case can include economic damages like lost financial support and funeral costs, as well as non-economic damages for loss of companionship.
